# Bank of Anthos Mobile (Flutter + Flame 2D)

> A modern, production-grade cross-platform mobile banking client for Google Cloud's Bank of Anthos microservices architecture, architected and built via Google Antigravity.

## Entity & Project Summary
- **Project Name**: Bank of Anthos Mobile
- **Repository**: https://github.com/JQCVSC/Complete-Bank-of-Anthos-mobile-app-with-Flutter-Flame-2D-Antigravity-architecture
- **Author**: JQCVSC
- **Architected By**: Google Antigravity (Google DeepMind's agentic AI coding assistant)
- **Framework**: Flutter 3.47+ / Dart 3.0+
- **Game & Physics Engine**: Flame 2D (v1.38.2)
- **Target Platforms**: Android (APK/AAB), iOS (IPA), Web (Wasm/CanvasKit)
- **Backend Reference**: Google Cloud Platform Bank of Anthos (GKE Kubernetes microservices)
- **License**: Apache 2.0

## Core Architecture & Systems
1. **Google Antigravity Agentic AI**: Autonomous planning, multi-agent code generation, self-healing diagnostic loops (`flutter analyze`, `flutter test`), and generative UI preview workflows.
2. **Flame 2D Engine Integration**:
   - `VaultMeshGame`: Interactive 2D microservices topology canvas displaying nodes (`frontend`, `ledgerwriter`, `balancereader`, etc.) with orbiting data lasers and touch-shockwave interactions.
   - `TransactionCelebrationGame`: Rigid-body particle coin fountains with Newtonian gravity ($980\text{ px/s}^2$) and restitution.
   - `AnthosQuestGame`: Arcade financial minigame where users control a vault collector paddle to catch coins and earn checking account bonuses.
3. **Dual-Mode Backend Engine**:
   - **Sandbox Demo Mode**: Fully offline, pre-seeded with realistic Bank of Anthos customer data (Alice Jackson, $12,450.75 balance, full transaction history, contacts).
   - **Live Cluster Mode**: Direct connectivity to any Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) Anthos Ingress Gateway with real-time `/ready` health probe monitoring.
4. **Clean MVVM & Provider Architecture**:
   - Presentation: `lib/ui/screens/`, `lib/ui/widgets/`
   - State: `AuthProvider`, `BankingProvider`, `SettingsProvider`
   - Repositories: `AuthRepository`, `BankingRepository`, `ContactsRepository`
   - Services: `ApiService`, `MockBankingService`, `StorageService`

## Microservices Endpoint Mapping
- `userservice`: `POST /login`, `POST /users` (Authentication & identity)
- `balancereader`: `GET /balances/{accountId}` (Real-time checking/savings balances)
- `ledgerwriter`: `POST /transactions` (Debit/credit ledger journal entries)
- `transactionhistory`: `GET /transactions/{accountId}` (Transaction ledger queries)
- `contacts`: `GET /contacts/{username}`, `POST /contacts` (Payee address book)

## Key Developer Commands
- Run on Android: `flutter run -d android`
- Run on iOS: `flutter run -d ios`
- Run Web: `flutter run -d chrome --web-port=8085`
- Run Analysis: `flutter analyze`
- Run Tests: `flutter test`
